Kiddie MDMA
I have used piracetam before and I stopped for a bit and started up again. I mix it with 500mg L-theanine and 400-500mg choline bitartrate. I have been using piracetam about 2g twice a day for 3 days and it works great because I have used it before. Here is my report of it mixed with kanna.
3:00 I arrive home from school in a great mood being on piracetam all day and I take a booster dose of 1.8g
3:15 my empty stomach brings on a fast onset so I feel great the kanna I ordered just came in the mail. I weigh out 250mg of kanna and I gently tap the scale dish on an angle so all the big stem like parts separate from the powder. I then  snort 200mg of powder (I know this because I weighed the resulting stemmy leftovers) and it burned my nose in a nice way :) kinda.
3:30 I feel very aroused and begin to read porn and eventually watch it. This leads to masturbating. It felt so good to masterbait I was in heaven and I have never felt so good masturbating and I do it often.
3:45 I have a powerful orgasm I feel the difference between the serotonin and the dopamine. The serotonin feeling definitely beat the dopamine feeling of the orgasm's finish which I was very surprised and dissapointed at.
4:00 it feels like weak MDMA and not the normal come up feeling of MDMA that kanna give me I mean straight up weak MDMA. Nothing but smiles and cheer.
4:15 appetite is suppressed and I feel rather nice and calm still, feeling the MDMA like effects although nothing close to the real thing.
In conclusion
The effects of kanna are as follows (note this is all subjective):
Short term effects- appetite suppression, euphoria, stimulant/muscle relaxing properties, and also pain reduction
Long term
Improved depression to the point of being cured (with 5-HTP as well, it may be dangerous to mix kanna with 5-HTP even though I did) and it also reduced my anxiety to the point of not needing benzos, lyrica, phenibut or alcohol everyday.
I also noticed when I quit weed it got rid of the craving completely which was a relief and it helped me sleep and have good dreams. Also one time I smoked a tiny bit of weed resin with 400mg kanna snorted and 100mg smoked, it was bedtime and I was so high I had CEV and I heard 3 songs clear as a bell. One was Jimi Hendrix I forget the other two songs. These CEV were very dream-like and comparable to 200mg DXM mixed with mushrooms.
